evidence: unreadable: Category labels run off the right frame edge — 'Properly recycled 22"' and 'Not properly recycle' clipped at seg2:start/seg2:mid/seg2:end, 'Met by e-waste recycl' and 'Met by new mining  9' clipped at seg3:start/seg3:mid; the title 'the world's growing e-waste pile' is covered by the mas

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg3:start and seg3:mid the two stacked-bar labels are cut by the right frame edge — 'Met by e-waste recycl' and 'Met by new mining  9' (the 99% and 1% values are outside the frame); by seg3:end the scene has emptied to two bins wedged under the title with the mascot covering the words 'the real cost' and the bottom two-thirds of the frame blank.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The stacked-bar category labels are drawn at a fixed x to the right of the mark with no measured text width against the 1080px safe area, so long labels plus their value overflow; the outgoing state of the scene releases the mark before the bin grid populates, leaving no composition and pushing the mascot up into the title band.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Measure each label (name + value) and place it fully inside the safe area — left-align inside the bar, or wrap/shrink so no glyph is clipped — and keep the 99%/1% marks filling the frame through the end of the beat with the mascot clear of the title band.
